surfaceContract: Ordinary rigid, low-traction indoor floor; not wet, oily or acutely unsafe. Ordinary shoes. Existing Floor, clothing and other physical filters remain independent.
scope: All 44 previously excluded distinct Room locomotion movements. The 10 Field movements and seven already-compatible Room movements are not counted in this 44-item review.
decisionStandard: An observed impact, concentrated contact, loaded sliding, forceful pivot or strong shear mechanism is required. Foot contact, travel direction, strength requirement or use of a mat in source footage alone does not establish incompatibility. These are observational product classifications, not measured shoe/floor friction certifications.

sources.use: Grip depends on the actual sole and surface; generic surface or footwear labels do not prove slip resistance.
Describes controlled toe and heel walking as distinct balance movements; not evidence that any slippery surface is suitable.

entries.name: Side Shuffle
entries.reason: Quick lateral push-offs and immediate reversals need side-to-side traction.

entries.name: Tiptoe Walking Back and Forth
entries.reason: Small controlled toe-first steps; no hop, forceful pivot or impact requiring cushioning. Forefoot contact alone is not an exclusion.
entries.reviewMethod: Chronological packaged-media frame review; native-speed playback and actual-workout checkpoints checked separately.

entries.name: Lateral Squat Walk
entries.reason: The demonstrated squat walk repeatedly pushes out of a wide bent-knee stance and reverses laterally at a brisk cadence.

entries.name: Heel Walks
entries.reason: Small controlled heel steps in ordinary shoes; no stamping or rapid heel strike. Heel-only contact does not itself require cushioning.
entries.reviewMethod: Chronological packaged-media frame review; native-speed playback and actual-workout checkpoints checked separately.

entries.name: Grapevine Step
entries.reason: Cross-behind lateral travel and direction reversals require reliable lateral and rotational footing.

entries.name: Deep-Squat Walk
entries.reason: Short controlled forward steps with the body kept low; no landing, planted-foot twist or additional floor contact. Depth and forefoot support alone are not surface exclusions.
entries.reviewMethod: Chronological packaged-media frame review; native-speed playback and actual-workout checkpoints checked separately.

entries.name: Walking Lunges
entries.reason: Long loaded split stances and forward braking require fore-aft shoe traction.

entries.name: Walking Lunges with Trunk Twist
entries.reason: Loaded walking-lunge split stances plus trunk rotation require dependable traction.

entries.name: Walking Lunges with Overhead Side Reach
entries.reason: Loaded walking-lunge split stances with an overhead side reach require dependable traction.

entries.name: Lateral Skipping
entries.reason: Repeated airborne lateral skips and landings.

entries.name: Lateral Crossover Skipping
entries.reason: Airborne crossover skips combine landing impact with lateral and rotational traction demands.

entries.name: Side Shuffle with Arm Swings
entries.reason: The demonstrated shuffle has quick side push-offs and bouncy landings, rather than controlled walking.

entries.name: Carioca with Knee Drive
entries.reason: Rapid crossover skips and knee drives require landing and rotational traction.

entries.name: Crossover Squat Walk
entries.reason: Deep cross-behind squat steps transfer load across a crossed stance and lateral direction changes.

entries.name: Diagonal Walking Lunges
entries.reason: Long diagonal lunge steps create loaded wide split stances and diagonal braking.

entries.name: Walking Crossover Lunges
entries.reason: Crossing walking lunges combine a loaded split stance with rotational control.

entries.name: Power Skipping for Height
entries.reason: Repeated powerful single-leg take-offs and landings.

entries.name: Walking Lunge to Power Skip
entries.reason: Long split-stance lunges alternate with powerful airborne skips.

entries.name: Forward Two-Foot Hops
entries.reason: Repeated forward two-foot take-offs and landings.

entries.name: Bear Crawl
entries.reason: Slow, short alternating hand-and-shoe steps with knees hovering; no jump, slide, forbidden contact or forceful wide-stance push-off.
entries.reviewMethod: Chronological packaged-media frame review; native-speed playback and actual-workout checkpoints checked separately.

entries.name: Crab Walk
entries.reason: Short controlled hand-and-foot steps with the body lifted; occasional seated setup contact is through the hips, not knees, elbows, head or trunk.
entries.reviewMethod: Chronological packaged-media frame review; native-speed playback and actual-workout checkpoints checked separately.

entries.name: Sideways Plank Walk
entries.reason: Controlled lateral placement of unloaded hands and feet while other contacts support the body; no hop, sliding or forceful lateral launch.
entries.reviewMethod: Chronological packaged-media frame review; native-speed playback and actual-workout checkpoints checked separately.

entries.name: Inchworm Crawl
entries.reason: Controlled hand walking to a supported plank and small foot steps back in; no jump or impact. The support demands are comparable to already-admitted controlled push-ups.
entries.reviewMethod: Chronological packaged-media frame review; native-speed playback and actual-workout checkpoints checked separately.

entries.name: Walking Push-Ups
entries.reason: Grounded push-ups alternate with controlled hand and foot placements; no plyometric push-off or sliding. The ordinary push-up itself is already admitted.
entries.reviewMethod: Chronological packaged-media frame review; native-speed playback and actual-workout checkpoints checked separately.

entries.name: Hands-and-Knees Crawl
entries.reason: Knees and lower legs repeatedly bear on the floor.

entries.name: Low Bear Crawl
entries.reason: Small controlled forward steps with knees held clear; no hop, slide or forbidden contact.
entries.reviewMethod: Chronological packaged-media frame review; native-speed playback and actual-workout checkpoints checked separately.

entries.name: Gorilla Crawl
entries.reason: Both feet bound forward toward planted hands, producing repeated foot landings; this is not a purely stepping crawl.

entries.name: Alligator Crawl
entries.reason: Long staggered diagonal hand-and-foot supports and wide advancing knees create stronger shear and anti-rotation demands than the compact bear crawl.

entries.name: Low Alligator Crawl
entries.reason: Very low wide diagonal supports and advancing bent elbows rely on strong hand-and-foot traction while the torso is close to the surface.

entries.name: Army Crawl
entries.reason: Loaded forearms and elbows repeatedly contact the floor.

entries.name: Kneeling Crawl with Sit-Through
entries.reason: Kneeling crawl and sit-through repeatedly load the knees; the sit-through also changes weight-bearing direction.

entries.name: Forward-and-Backward Plank Walk
entries.reason: Small controlled forward and backward hand-and-foot placements from a supported plank; no hop, slide or forbidden contact.
entries.reviewMethod: Chronological packaged-media frame review; native-speed playback and actual-workout checkpoints checked separately.

entries.name: Sideways Bear Crawl
entries.reason: The packaged sideways bear-crawl clip includes knee contact during its transitions. A knees-up variation would need its own reviewed footage.

entries.name: Sideways Crab Walk
entries.reason: Slow controlled sideways hand-and-foot placements with the hips lifted; no jump, slide, loaded pivot or forbidden contact.
entries.reviewMethod: Chronological packaged-media frame review; native-speed playback and actual-workout checkpoints checked separately.

entries.name: Sideways Gorilla Crawl
entries.reason: Hand-supported lateral bounds transfer both feet together with repeated landings.

entries.name: Frog Jumps
entries.reason: The actual catalog demo is Frog Jumps, with repeated airborne jumps and landings; it is not a slow stepping frog walk.

entries.name: Bunny Hops
entries.reason: Hand-supported hops include knee contact in the packaged transition.

entries.name: Burpee Broad Jumps
entries.reason: Repeated broad-jump landings plus torso contact in the burpee phase.

entries.name: Log Rolls
entries.reason: Rolling loads the head, torso and shoulders repeatedly.
entries.floorContactPoints: Feet, Hands, Forearms, Head, Torso, Shoulders, Hips, Thighs, LowerLegs

entries.name: Seated Buttock Walks
entries.reason: Repeated loaded seat-bone advances and rubbing on the floor make a rigid surface meaningfully less ergonomic; this is concentrated hip loading, not a forbidden-contact bit.

entries.name: Handstand Walk
entries.reason: Near-full-body palm loading during a moving inversion requires reliable hand grip and controlled inverted balance.

entries.name: Straight-Leg Cartwheels
entries.reason: Lateral inverted travel with sequential hand loading and foot landings requires dependable traction.

entries.name: One-Arm Cartwheels
entries.reason: Lateral inverted travel concentrates the support on one hand before the landing.

entries.name: Side Aerials
entries.reason: Airborne lateral inversion has a committed take-off and landing that depend on traction and impact control.

runtimeReview.scope: Isolated synthetic workouts in the actual web app; no genuine workout state was edited.

pairedMovement.observation: The second block retains the opposite-hand-position cue and mirrored copy of the same reviewed full loop.
